children: PBF Energy Inc. (PBF) filed a Form 8K - Direct or off-Balance Sheet Financial Obligation - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 17, 2026.
The information required by Item 2.03 relating to the Notes and the Indenture is contained in Item 1.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K above and is incorporated by reference herein.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1534504/000119312526394108/d175053d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1534504/000119312526394108/0001193125-26-394108-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
